description: The space of positive integers under the Collatz map viewed as a fitness landscape where fitness = delay D(n). Delay records are peaks. The landscape has fractal structure with self-similar ridges.
mathematical_formalization: Define fitness f(n) = D(n). Mutational neighborhood of n is {n-1, n+1, 2n, n/2}. A ridge is a maximal connected set with D(n) > D(m) for all m not on the ridge.
analogical_connections: Wright's adaptive landscape: delay records are fitness peaks
Kauffman's NK model: ruggedness depends on coupling between digits
Spin glass models: quenched disorder from 3x+1 and x/2 interplay
implementation_hypothesis: Genetic algorithm evolving populations of integers with delay as fitness and bit-flip mutations.
experiment_seed: Map local fitness landscape around each known delay record for n in [record-1000, record+1000].
